description: Aljal Ipsi (알잘 입시): Search Korean university admissions data by university, major, admission track, or recruiting-unit name. Returns up to 5 matches, each with a one-line summary, an id for get_admission_details, and the ipsi.aljal.kr page URL. Source: the official admission guide of each university. Matching is by Korean name, not by meaning: English names are not matched, so pass short Korean names such as 의예과, 간호, 지역균형, 학생부종합, 축구. Results are in Korean. 대학명·학과명·전형명·모집단위명으로 찾습니다.

query.description: Major, track, or unit name in Korean (translate English first), e.g. "의예과", "지역균형", "간호". A university name alone also works, e.g. "서울대". 학과명·전형명·대학명.

school.description: Optional university name or common short name in Korean to narrow results, e.g. "서울대", "숙명여대", "이대". 대학명 또는 약칭.

season.description: Optional admission round: 수시 (early) or 정시 (regular).

name: search_admissions
title: 대학 입시 정보 찾기
